home.label: Home
home.selectionRule: Recommend only movements requiring no apparatus beyond bodyweight, a yoga mat, or an ordinary wall.
home.notes: Confirmed user context: bodyweight-focused home training with a yoga mat. No pull-up bar, dip station, bench, chair, box, step platform, door/furniture anchor, bands, weights or other apparatus are assumed.

apartmentGym.label: Apartment Gym
apartmentGym.verificationMethod: Four user-provided gym photos reviewed visually; a full dumbbell set was additionally confirmed directly by the user. Model-level claims are separated from function-level observations.

verifiedStations.label: HOIST Mi7Smith functional training system
verifiedStations.basis: Visible MiSmith and Mi7 branding plus matching combined frame geometry; manufacturer documentation confirms the combined system functions.
verifiedStations.notes: Use the cable trainer broadly. Treat generic machine-catalog exercises as available only when separately supported by the machine capability keywords.

verifiedStations.label: Bench at Smith/functional trainer
verifiedStations.basis: Bench is clearly visible in use inside the Smith station.

verifiedStations.label: Full dumbbell set
verifiedStations.basis: The user explicitly confirmed that the Apartment Gym has a full dumbbell set after the photo-based inventory was captured. Brand, exact weight range and increments remain unverified.

verifiedStations.label: Selectorized lat pulldown / low-row station
verifiedStations.basis: Wide pulldown bar, thigh restraint, low cable and row foot supports/handles are visible.

verifiedStations.label: Life Fitness leg extension / seated leg curl station
verifiedStations.basis: Life Fitness branding and dual roller/seat geometry are visible; exact series/model plate was not legible.

verifiedStations.label: Life Fitness shoulder press station
verifiedStations.basis: Life Fitness branding, upright seat/back and overhead press lever geometry are visible.

verifiedStations.label: Life Fitness pectoral fly / rear deltoid station
verifiedStations.basis: Life Fitness branding and separate Pectoral Fly / Rear Delt instruction labels are visible.

verifiedStations.label: Concept2 rowing ergometer
verifiedStations.basis: Concept2 branding and RowErg form factor are visible.

apartmentGym.selectionRule: Use the confirmed dumbbells plus the verified cable trainer, Smith system, pull-up/dip stations, bench and stability balls. Generic machine exercises require a verified machine-function keyword so the presence of one selectorized machine does not falsely unlock every machine exercise in the catalog.
apartmentGym.notes: The apartment profile combines photo-verified stations with the user's explicit confirmation of a full dumbbell set. Do not infer other unverified free weights, accessories or machine types. Additional evidence can expand this profile without changing prior workout history.

fullGym.label: Full Gym
fullGym.selectionRule: Treat standard free weights, machines and common training apparatus as available unless a later specific-gym profile marks an item unavailable.
fullGym.notes: Generic all-equipment gym profile. Can be refined later without changing workout-history records.
